user.title: EV Smart Charge Setup
user.description: Configure your EV charging optimiser. Prices are fetched from AgilePredict ({api_url}) — a free ML-based Octopus Agile price predictor for UK customers.

data.name: Integration name
data.min_soc: Minimum acceptable SOC (%) — never drop below this
data.soc_entity: Home Assistant entity for current battery SOC (optional)
data.charger_switch: Home Assistant switch entity for EV charger (optional)

data_description.region: Find your region from your electricity bill MPAN (digits 9–10) or the Octopus Energy website.
data_description.battery_capacity: Total usable capacity of your EV battery in kWh.
data_description.charge_rate: Maximum AC charge rate of your home charger in kW.
data_description.target_soc: The SOC percentage to charge to during normal sessions.
data_description.min_soc: If battery drops to this level, charging starts immediately regardless of price.
data_description.departure_time: The integration will ensure charging completes before this time each day.
data_description.soc_entity: e.g. sensor.my_car_battery_level — used for historical analysis and live decisions.
data_description.charger_switch: e.g. switch.ev_charger — if set, the integration can control charging automatically.
